name: omp-ask-more
description: One ask for every user decision: native ask parameters extended with a brief, evidence and per-option tradeoffs, answered on a fullscreen page or Tern sheet

timeout.description: Whole idle seconds before the first step; 0 disables timing

returnTimeout.description: Whole seconds after notification before the model decides

onExpiry.description: Decide unanswered questions or keep waiting after the countdown

notify.terminal.description: Send a terminal notification when idle time expires

notify.command.description: Trusted shell notification command; project-sourced commands are ignored

readability.judge.description: When a judge model is available, reject asks it finds hard to understand so the agent rewrites them
